_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).

events.label: Haitian Revolution begins
events.desc: Enslaved people rise in the north of French Saint-Domingue.

events.label: Haiti declares independence
events.desc: Jean-Jacques Dessalines proclaims the independence of Haiti at Gonaïves.

events.label: Portuguese court leaves Lisbon for Brazil
events.wiki: Transfer of the Portuguese court to Brazil
events.desc: Fleeing Napoleon's invasion, the royal family sails for Brazil and makes Rio de Janeiro the seat of the Portuguese empire in 1808.

events.label: May Revolution in Buenos Aires
events.desc: The viceroy is replaced by a local junta, the Primera Junta.

events.label: Cry of Dolores
events.desc: The priest Miguel Hidalgo calls for revolt; the Mexican War of Independence begins.

events.label: Paraguay breaks with Spain
events.desc: A bloodless coup in Asunción ends Spanish rule.

events.label: Venezuela declares independence
events.desc: A congress in Caracas declares independence from Spain.

events.label: Argentina declares independence
events.desc: The Congress of Tucumán declares the independence of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata.

events.label: Battle of Chacabuco
events.desc: San Martín's Army of the Andes defeats the royalists after crossing the mountains.

events.label: Battle of Maipú
events.desc: San Martín's victory secures Chilean independence.

events.label: Battle of Boyacá
events.desc: Bolívar's victory opens the way to Bogotá.

events.label: Gran Colombia created
events.desc: The Congress of Angostura unites Venezuela and New Granada in one republic.

events.label: Battle of Carabobo
events.desc: Bolívar's victory decides Venezuelan independence.

events.label: Peru declares independence
events.desc: San Martín proclaims the independence of Peru in Lima.

events.label: Central America declares independence
events.wiki: Act of Independence of Central America
events.desc: The provinces of the Captaincy General of Guatemala declare independence from Spain.

events.label: Mexican independence achieved
events.desc: The Army of the Three Guarantees enters Mexico City.

events.label: Battle of Pichincha
events.desc: Sucre's victory frees Quito.

events.label: Guayaquil Conference
events.desc: Bolívar and San Martín meet; San Martín then withdraws from Peru.

events.label: Brazil declares independence
events.desc: Prince Pedro declares independence from Portugal and becomes Emperor Pedro I.

events.label: Monroe Doctrine
events.desc: The United States declares the Americas closed to new European colonisation.

events.label: Battle of Junín
events.desc: Bolívar defeats the royalists in the Peruvian highlands.

events.label: Battle of Ayacucho
events.desc: Sucre defeats the last large Spanish army in South America.

events.label: Bolivia declares independence
events.desc: Upper Peru becomes the republic of Bolivia.

events.label: Uruguayan patriots declare independence from Brazil; Cisplatine War begins
events.desc: The declaration at Florida starts the Cisplatine War; independence is recognised in 1828.
